chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: First hearing of Kid Ory, Teagarden and Ellington
summary: He knew none of the famous musicians until Chicago or New York; the biggest band he knew before was Helvey's.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: When did you first hear, or hear about, Kid Ory?
I can't tell you.
You don't remember?
No, because I was in school.
You were at Morris Brown then?
Yeah.
He didn't come through Atlanta, did he?
I didn't know nothing about Kid Ory until I think
T351 T3A
I came to New York. I heard about him in Chicago.
When did you first meet Jack Teagarden, or hear about him?
Right here in New York.
What about Duke Ellington?
Duke? You mean, when did I meet him?
When did you first hear Duke, or hear about him?
In New York.
So most of the famous musicians, you didn't really get to see them until Chicago or New York?
No, no, no.
Did you meet any in Cleveland - Cincinnati?
Sure, in Cincinnati, I just told you that. That's what I told you yesterday. That's when I was in school.
Right, but I'm saying, did you hear any of the big bands or anything like that?
